source.name: Run Away
source.originalDescription: Restores the Pokémon's HP and nullifies damage from Pokémon from the opposing team. This Ability goes on a 30s cooldown after it's triggered.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Run Away には、直接ダメージや単純移動以外の特殊効果を検出していません。

baseAction.notes: 直接ダメージと単純移動はbaseActionへ保存し、特殊効果件数には含めない。

source.name: Attack
source.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Attack は 通常攻撃回数により強化攻撃になる。

source.name: Swift
source.originalDescription: Has the user shoots 6 star-shaped rays in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit and reducing their movement speed by 35% for 0.3s. The user is slowed by 30% while casting this move. The slow duration is extended by 0.3s for each star that hits the same Pokémon.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Swift は 移動速度を下げる。
